# Environment textures (credits)

All files here come from [Poly Haven](https://polyhaven.com) and are **CC0** (public domain, free for any use, no attribution required — credited anyway). They were resized and re-encoded for the game; the leaf, twig and grass cards combine Poly Haven's colour and alpha maps into one WebP.
